aws_nist_s3_bucket_cross_region_replicat.summary: Configure and verify an approved S3 replication rule to a bucket in a different Region.
steps: Inspect the source bucket's replication rules and the source and destination bucket Regions; confirm which data must be replicated and the owner-approved destination.
Review destination ownership, data residency, replication role permissions, encryption, versioning, retention, and cost with the data owner before changing configuration.
Configure an enabled rule for the approved destination under change control, then read back the rule and both bucket Regions and verify replication of a permitted test object.
caveats: Both source and destination buckets require versioning for operational replication. This check tests the signed rule/Region predicate only and does not prove object delivery or include pre-existing objects.
A destination outside the same-account, same-partition collected inventory or with unreadable Location remains UNKNOWN. Obtain authorized destination-Region evidence before claiming PASS or FAIL.
Replication can add storage, request, and data transfer charges; apply only after workload and residency review.

field_binding.path: Name; AccountId; context.scope/Account/metadata.caller_identities[].Arn partition; complete bucket envelope scope/account_id/global; Replication.ReplicationConfiguration.Rules[].Status; Rules[].Destination.Bucket; Location.LocationConstraint
